dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: Oh, that's a capital idea. But if we had those, would we really need waterways?

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: They're pretty convenient as-is — and speaking of that, I did have some dealings with Callas, the fellow who helped to build said waterways.

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: It was thanks to him that I was able to make it as a shipborne merchant... Ah, what a shame...

dialogues.speaker: Xugney
dialogues.text: I wonder how his daughter, Navia, is doing. I should go say hello if I get the chance...
